description:
USE THIS TOOL WHEN searching UK Parliament petitions by keyword or topic.

Returns petition title, state, signature count, and dates for government
response or parliamentary debate if applicable. Filter by state (open,
closed, debated, etc.) to narrow to live or historical petitions.

This is the authoritative source for UK Parliament petitions
(petition.parliament.uk).

offset.description: Number of petitions to skip before this page. Default 0. Re-call with offset=offset+returned while has_more is true.

query.description: Search term for petition titles, e.g. 'ban trophy hunting' or 'NHS funding'.

name: parliament_search_petitions

outputSchema.description:
Result of a UK Parliament petitions search.

Wraps the matching petitions with the originating query and state
filter.

has_more.description: True if a full page was returned (more may exist)

petitions.description: Matching petitions (title, state, signature count, key dates, URL).

debate_date.description: Date the petition was debated, if any

government_response_at.description: Date of government response, if any

query.description: The term that was searched in petitions

state.description: Petition state filter applied to this query

total.description: Number of petitions returned in this call

title: Search UK Parliament Petitions
